card.name: Words just before a duration or amount
card.fires_on: Small linking words, units or spaces right before a number in dosing text, such as "for" before 3 days, "of" before 5 minutes, or "than" before 11 g/dL.

modes.label: Before a duration
modes.description: The word or space just before a number of days, weeks or minutes.
modes.example: Apply twice daily morning and evening (every 12 hours),<< for>> 3 consecutive days, then withhold use

modes.label: Before a threshold or range
modes.description: A linking word or unit just before a limit or range value.
modes.example: Targeting a hemoglobin level of greater<< than>> 11 g/dL is expected

modes.label: Inside a dosing instruction
modes.description: A word in a dosing phrase that leads into what must be adjusted or individualized.
modes.example: dosage must<< be>> individualized according to age and weight,

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning sufficient or adequate, so a specific number is expected next instead.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a dose number, time span or limit in a label.
